ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida pre-encryption defense evasion: SILENTKILL.ps1 / shadow-copy wipe + log clear chain
ucs.description: Rhysida operators consistently run a 'SILENTKILL'-style PowerShell script (documented by CISA AA23-319A and Sophos/Trend) that disables AV/EDR services, clears Windows event logs, deletes Volume Shadow Copies and disables recovery — all in a tight burst on the same host minutes before the ransomware binary detonates. The chain `powershell -> Stop-Service/Set-MpPreference -> wevtutil cl -> vssadmin delete shadows -> bcdedit recoveryenabled No` is a near-fingerprint for this crew (Vice Society lineage).
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as childbins from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wevtutil.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","reg.exe","cipher.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval shadow_wipe=if(match(cmdlines,"(?i)vssadmin.*delete\s+shadows|wbadmin\s+delete\s+catalog|wmic.*shadowcopy.*delete"),1,0), recovery_off=if(match(cmdlines,"(?i)bcdedit.*recoveryenabled\s+No|bcdedit.*bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures"),1,0), log_clear=if(match(cmdlines,"(?i)wevtutil\s+cl\s+(Security|System|Application|Windows\s+PowerShell)"),1,0), av_disable=if(match(cmdlines,"(?i)Set-MpPreference\s+-Disable|Stop-Service.*Defender|sc\s+(stop|delete)\s+(WinDefend|Sense|MsMpSvc)|reg\s+add.*DisableAntiSpyware\s+/t\s+REG_DWORD\s+/d\s+1"),1,0) | eval score = shadow_wipe + recovery_off + log_clear + av_disable | where score >= 3 | table firstTime lastTime dest user score cmdlines childbins
ucs.kql:
// Rhysida SILENTKILL chain — defender evasion burst on one host
let Lookback = 7d;
let Window = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wevtutil.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","wmic.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","reg.exe","cipher.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| extend ShadowWipe = iff(ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)vssadmin.*delete\s+shadows|wbadmin\s+delete\s+catalog|shadowcopy.*delete|wmic.*shadowcopy", 1, 0)
| extend RecoveryOff = iff(ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)bcdedit.*recoveryenabled\s+No|bcdedit.*bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures", 1, 0)
| extend LogClear = iff(ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)wevtutil\s+cl\s+(Security|System|Application|Windows\s+PowerShell)", 1, 0)
| extend AvDisable = iff(ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)Set-MpPreference\s+-Disable|Stop-Service.*(Defender|Sense|WinDefend|MsMpSvc)|sc\s+(stop|delete)\s+(WinDefend|Sense|MsMpSvc)|reg\s+add.*DisableAntiSpyware\s+/t\s+REG_DWORD\s+/d\s+0*1|fltMC.*unload", 1, 0)
| extend CipherWipe = iff(FileName =~ "cipher.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/w", 1, 0)
| where ShadowWipe + RecoveryOff + LogClear + AvDisable + CipherWipe >= 1
| summarize StartTime = min(Timestamp), EndTime = max(Timestamp),
            ShadowWipe = max(ShadowWipe), RecoveryOff = max(RecoveryOff),
            LogClear = max(LogClear), AvDisable = max(AvDisable), CipherWipe = max(CipherWipe),
            CmdLines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            ChildBins = make_set(FileName, 15)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| extend Score = ShadowWipe + RecoveryOff + LogClear + AvDisable + CipherWipe
| where Score >= 3   // ≥3 of the 5 distinct SILENTKILL behaviours within 10m
| order by Score desc, StartTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Rhysida SILENTKILL chain on Sentinel — Security 4688 + DeviceProcessEvents fallback
let Lookback = 7d;
let Window = 10m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" and TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where Bin in ("vssadmin.exe","wevtutil.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","wmic.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","reg.exe","cipher.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| extend ShadowWipe = iff(CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)vssadmin.*delete\s+shadows|wbadmin\s+delete\s+catalog|shadowcopy.*delete|wmic.*shadowcopy", 1, 0)
| extend RecoveryOff = iff(CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)bcdedit.*recoveryenabled\s+No|bcdedit.*bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures", 1, 0)
| extend LogClear = iff(CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)wevtutil\s+cl\s+(Security|System|Application|Windows\s+PowerShell)", 1, 0)
| extend AvDisable = iff(CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)Set-MpPreference\s+-Disable|Stop-Service.*(Defender|Sense|WinDefend|MsMpSvc)|sc\s+(stop|delete)\s+(WinDefend|Sense|MsMpSvc)|reg\s+add.*DisableAntiSpyware|fltMC.*unload", 1, 0)
| extend CipherWipe = iff(Bin == "cipher.exe" and CommandLine has "/w", 1, 0)
| where ShadowWipe + RecoveryOff + LogClear + AvDisable + CipherWipe >= 1
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated),
            ShadowWipe = max(ShadowWipe), RecoveryOff = max(RecoveryOff),
            LogClear = max(LogClear), AvDisable = max(AvDisable), CipherWipe = max(CipherWipe),
            CmdLines = make_set(CommandLine, 25)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| extend Score = ShadowWipe + RecoveryOff + LogClear + AvDisable + CipherWipe
| where Score >= 3
| order by Score desc, StartTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.security @EventID:4688 OR source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1) AND (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\wevtutil.exe OR *\WEVTUTIL.EXE OR *\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBADMIN.EXE OR *\cipher.exe OR *\CIPHER.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe)) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"recoveryenabled No"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"wevtutil cl"* OR *"Set-MpPreference -Disable"* OR *"Stop-Service"*WinDefend* OR *"sc stop WinDefend"* OR *"DisableAntiSpyware"* OR *"cipher /w"*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query: #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 | ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wevtutil|bcdedit|wbadmin|wmic|sc|reg|cipher|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i | regex("(?i)delete\\s+shadows|recoveryenabled\\s+No|bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures|wevtutil\\s+cl\\s+(Security|System|Application)|Set-MpPreference\\s+-Disable|Stop-Service.*(Defender|WinDefend|Sense)|sc\\s+(stop|delete)\\s+(WinDefend|Sense)|DisableAntiSpyware|fltMC.*unload|cipher\\s+/w", field=CommandLine) | bin := bucket(span=10m, field=@timestamp) | groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, bin], function=[count(as=hits), collect([CommandLine, ImageFileName])]) | hits >= 3 | sort(hits, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: CISA AA23-319A and Sophos's Rhysida write-ups document the operators executing a single PowerShell wrapper (sometimes named SILENTKILL.ps1 / k1.bat) that collapses defender disable, event-log wipe, shadow-copy delete and bcdedit recovery flip into the same minutes-long burst on every host they touch before encryption. Generic ransomware crews do one or two of these — Rhysida runs 3+ in tight seque

ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida lateral payload push: PsExec/WMIC drop of .exe to remote ADMIN$ followed by rapid mass-file rename to .rhysida
ucs.description: Rhysida operators stage the encryptor on a beachhead, then push the binary across SMB ADMIN$ via PsExec (often renamed) or WMIC process call create, executing it as SYSTEM on dozens of servers in minutes. The post-execution signal is the encryptor mass-renaming files with the .rhysida extension and dropping CriticalBreachDetected.pdf into every folder — the combination of cross-host SMB write + rapid .rhysida fan-out from the same SHA256 is unique to this actor.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_name) as files values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.rhysida" OR Filesystem.file_name="CriticalBreachDetected.pdf" OR (Filesystem.file_path="*\\ADMIN$\\*" AND Filesystem.file_name="*.exe")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.user _time span=5m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | eval is_rhysida_ext=if(match(files,"(?i)\.rhysida$"),1,0), is_ransom_note=if(match(files,"(?i)CriticalBreachDetected\.pdf"),1,0), is_admin_share_drop=if(match(paths,"(?i)\\\\\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\(ADMIN\$|C\$)\\\\.*\.exe$"),1,0) | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime sum(is_rhysida_ext) as ext_renames sum(is_ransom_note) as notes sum(is_admin_share_drop) as remote_drops values(dest) as hosts values(process_name) as procs by user | where (ext_renames > 50 OR notes >= 3) OR (remote_drops >= 2 AND ext_renames >= 1) | table firstTime lastTime user hosts procs ext_renames notes remote_drops
ucs.kql:
// Rhysida payload-push + encryption fan-out
let Lookback = 24h;
let RemoteExeDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^\\\\[^\\]+\\(ADMIN\$|C\$)\\"
    | where FileName endswith ".exe"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DropTime=Timestamp, SourceDevice=DeviceName, SourceUser=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              DroppedTo=FolderPath, DroppedName=FileName, SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let PsExecOrWmiExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where (FileName =~ "psexec.exe" or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "psexesvc.exe" or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "psexec.exe"
             or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "wmic.exe" and InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_all ("process","call","create")))
    | project ExecTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let RhysidaArtifacts = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where (FileName endswith ".rhysida") or (FileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf")
    | summarize FirstArtifact=min(Timestamp), LastArtifact=max(Timestamp),
                RenameCount = countif(FileName endswith ".rhysida"),
                NoteCount = countif(FileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"),
                Writer = any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
                WriterSHA = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
                by DeviceId, DeviceName;
RhysidaArtifacts
| where RenameCount >= 50 or NoteCount >= 3
| join kind=leftouter (RemoteExeDrops) on $left.DeviceName == $right.DropTime  // placeholder no-op to keep shape
| project DeviceName, FirstArtifact, LastArtifact, RenameCount, NoteCount, Writer, WriterSHA
| order by RenameCount desc
| union (
    PsExecOrWmiExec
    | join kind=inner (RemoteExeDrops) on $left.DeviceName == $right.SourceDevice
    | where ExecTime between (DropTime - 2m .. DropTime + 30m)
    | project DropTime, ExecTime, SourceDevice, SourceUser, DroppedTo, DroppedName, SHA256,
              SpawningCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine
    | order by DropTime desc
  )
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Rhysida payload-push + encryption fan-out on Sentinel
let Lookback = 24h;
let RhysidaArtifacts = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
    | where TargetFileExtension =~ "rhysida" or TargetFileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"
    | summarize FirstArtifact = min(TimeGenerated), LastArtifact = max(TimeGenerated),
                RenameCount = countif(TargetFileExtension =~ "rhysida"),
                NoteCount = countif(TargetFileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"),
                Writer = any(ActingProcessName),
                WriterCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine)
                by DvcHostname;
let PsExecOrWmic = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where TargetProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(psexec|psexesvc|paexec)\.exe$"
         or (ParentProcessName =~ "services.exe" and TargetProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\PSEXESVC")
         or (TargetProcessCommandLine has_all ("wmic","process","call","create"))
    | project ExecTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName;
RhysidaArtifacts
| where RenameCount >= 50 or NoteCount >= 3
| project DvcHostname, FirstArtifact, LastArtifact, RenameCount, NoteCount, Writer, WriterCmd
| union (
    PsExecOrWmic
    | join kind=inner (RhysidaArtifacts) on DvcHostname
    | where ExecTime between (FirstArtifact - 30m .. LastArtifact)
    | project ExecTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, RenameCount, NoteCount
  )
| order by RenameCount desc, FirstArtifact desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 OR source:windows.security @EventID:4663) AND (@TargetFilename:(*.rhysida OR *.RHYSIDA) OR @TargetFilename:(*\CriticalBreachDetected.pdf OR *\criticalbreachdetected.pdf) OR (@TargetFilename:(*\ADMIN$\* OR *\admin$\* OR *\C$\* OR *\c$\*) AND @TargetFilename:(*.exe OR *.EXE)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query: (#event_simpleName=FileWritten OR #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2) | case { #event_simpleName=FileWritten | regex("(?i)(\\.rhysida$|\\\\CriticalBreachDetected\\.pdf$|\\\\\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\(ADMIN\\$|C\\$)\\\\.*\\.exe$)", field=TargetFileName) ; #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 | ImageFileName=/\\(psexec|psexesvc|paexec)\.exe$/i OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i CommandLine=/process\s+call\s+create/i) } | groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[count(as=events), collect([TargetFileName, CommandLine, ImageFileName])]) | events >= 5 | sort(events, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The .rhysida extension and the ransom-note filename CriticalBreachDetected.pdf are documented in CISA AA23-319A, Trend Micro, and SentinelOne's Rhysida reports — they are not used by other extant ransomware families, so file-system telemetry alone is near-zero-FP.
